title: Last.fm Scrobble Weekly Track Length Trend
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player/achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr/Radarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lastfm:scrobble track_length_s=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(track_length_s) as avg_duration, max(track_length_s) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst track length for Last.fm scrobble events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture track_length_s on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average track length with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It neatly whether Last.fm scrobble tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
